title: Story premise ENT009: The Hat That Needed a Chair
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (physical comedy). Hook: The hat has requested its own seat. Takeaway/theme: A decorative requirement does not have to control the whole person.
description: A figure wants to wear an enormous formal hat, but its towering decorations keep bending the wearer into increasingly strange poses. The figure seats the hat on its own stool and wears only the detachable band, while guests line up to compliment the hat as if it were a person.
